ut_sos_file_2014.transcription: parsed with readxl (row 1 = merged district header, row 2 = candidate (party)); every district's candidate columns sum exactly to that district's own printed OFFICE SUM row (02af_house_ut_2012_2014.R). Replaces the OpenElections-sourced rows, which were genuinely partial (15/29 counties in 2012, 25/29 in 2014 -- missing per-county files in that repo, not a parsing issue).
ut_sos_file_2014.license: No license or terms stated on the pages/files used; official public record published by the state agency. Reuse terms not confirmed. Terms check 2026-09-23: utah.gov disclaimer: 'Anyone may view, copy, or distribute information found within these web pages ... for personal or informational use without owing an obligation to the State if the documents are not modified in any respect'; footer 'Copyright State of Utah'. Ambiguous for derived tables.
ut_sos_file_2014.notes: Utah had 4 U.S. House districts both years (redistricted after the 2010 census, up from 3 in 1990-2010)
